case_title: WALKER, PAULINE VS SMITH, MARGARET EMPLOYEE SFCO HOUSING AUTHORITY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $150.00 FILED BY WALKER, PAULINE AS TO DEFENDANT SMITH, MARGARET EMPLOYEE SFCO HOUSING AUTHORITY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-08-2001 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT SMITH, MARGARET EMPLOYEE SFCO HOUSING AUTHORITY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WALKER, PAULINE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SMITH, MARGARET EMPLOYEE SFCO HOUSING AUTHORITY MARGARET SMITH IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. THE DEFENDANT IS SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY. SAN FRANCISCO HOUSING AUTHORITY WAIVES GOVERNMENT CLAIM REQUIREMENT. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS AMENDED TO $300.00. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
